summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd, a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 4, 2026, to disclose its proxy statement and notice of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for September 15, 2026. The meeting agenda consists solely of two routine items: adopting a fourth amended and restated memorandum and articles of association for housekeeping matters and authorizing adjournment if needed for proxy solicitation. No special-situations event such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is announced. The filing is a routine corporate governance matter under Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers.
